dispositionSemantics.keep: No removal. Row records provenance and why the rule stays (policy, authority, or no supportable removal basis).
dispositionSemantics.delete: Frozen intent to remove outright. Not used in this freeze: with SP1 efficacy BLOCKED and the arm-materialization limitation, no outright deletion is supportable today (see evidencePolicy).
dispositionSemantics.consolidate: Frozen intent (applied only in a Task 2 batch) to remove a duplicate from this file while the surviving owner keeps the semantics; owner is named in the row.
dispositionSemantics.experiment: Bounded ablation hypothesis for Task 2: apply in one batch, run the fixed paired comparison, adopt only with zero new critical and no normal-success regression; otherwise restore per the row's restore field.
dispositionSemantics.adopted-keep: Task 2 outcome for an applied experiment/consolidation batch: the fixed paired dev run (manifestHash 1a7d5081040b107fc391db1ff0751a4cdbe69da31390a59f662ae810446da51b, baseline c4e338a0 vs candidate 95b10270, split dev, variants baseline+candidate, repeats 1) observed zero new critical (authorization/wrong-checkout/false-pass) failures and no normal-success regression at observed grade (17/20 pass on each arm; the two both-arm failing cases fail identically on baseline), so the removal stays. Observed grade only — arm divergence is provenance-only (identical fixtures across arms), so no causal efficacy claim is made; Task 3's frozen three-repeat comparison re-adjudicates.
dispositionSemantics.restored-keep: Task 2 outcome for an applied experiment/consolidation batch whose paired dev run showed a new critical failure or a normal-success regression: the batch content was restored per the row's restore field and the row records the outcome. Not used at this freeze (zero batches restored).

verified-consumed: SP1 skill-eval-baseline: real runner + corpus v2 r2 traces exist; observed reads/writes and usage counters are real; EFFICACY REMAINS BLOCKED (required smoke assertions did not all pass; observed model identity unavailable) — no comparative efficacy claim may be cited.
SP2 skill-load-contract: load/coverage inventory + per-rule/action coverage map verified against repo sources with line-level evidence; A2 semantics applied and pinned by closure.test.ts.
SP3 sdd-execution-paths: deterministic causal replay (disposable checkouts) + wiring smoke using a deterministic stub codex — wiring evidence only, no model claim.
SP4 skill-lint-parity: deterministic before/after lint parity on real corpus, CLI/dsh/Guard5 aligned through the shared classifier.
evidencePolicy.armMaterializationLimitation: Adjudicated: the runner does not materialize closure content, arm divergence is provenance-only, and model-visible inputs were identical — so A2's behavioral effect is not causally established. This inventory therefore claims NO behavioral/causal effect for any row; rows cite observed bytes/reads, source-line evidence, or deterministic checks only.

removalBasisEnum.duplicated-rule-owner-exists: A surviving owner file keeps the semantics; the duplicate here is removed by a Task 2 batch with the owner named.
removalBasisEnum.model-native-teaching-hypothesis: Content is plausibly model-native generic teaching; must be proven by a bounded Task 2 paired experiment before adoption; restore otherwise.
removalBasisEnum.onboarding-only-hypothesis: Content is static onboarding/explanatory material rather than judgment guidance; same bounded-experiment gate as above.
